posts_platforms_valid.name: posts_platforms_valid
posts_platforms_valid.value: cardinality("posts"."platforms") BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND array_position("posts"."platforms", NULL) IS NULL AND (cardinality("posts"."platforms") = 1 OR "posts"."platforms"[1] <> "posts"."platforms"[2])

posts_instagram_image_required.name: posts_instagram_image_required
posts_instagram_image_required.value: "posts"."status" = 'draft' OR NOT ('instagram'::post_platform = ANY("posts"."platforms")) OR "posts"."image_key" IS NOT NULL OR "posts"."image_url" LIKE 'https://%'
